svg.title: Cabloy Admin Implementation Roadmap
svg.desc: Implementation Roadmap. 33 formal WBS tasks. Current derived status reviewed 2026-09-01. Relative positions and overlap are illustrative; they are not calendar dates, duration, staffing, or concurrency commitments.
svg.metadata: Derived from pdp-wbs.md, test-plan.md, and progress.md. This SVG is not planning authority.

g.aria-label: WBS-ADM-100-01: Establish paired admin-menu module ownership; Implementation complete
g.title: WBS-ADM-100-01: Establish paired admin-menu module ownership; dependencies: `WBS-ADM-90-08`. This refactoring moves role-menu domain ownership from the existing `admin-rbac` implementation to paired `admin-menu` modules. It preserves the approved menu-visibility behavior and independent authorization boundary, creates no new suite or Admin site, intentionally permits menu API and generated-consumer renaming during development, and keeps each affected `vonaModule.fileVersion` at `1`.; Implementation complete
g.text: `WBS-ADM-90-08`. This refactoring moves role-menu domain ownership from the existing `admin-rbac` implementation to paired `admin-menu` modules.
